criteria.detail: Source renders PR state plus #number inside UrlLink; title exists only in aria-label/title. Screenshots contain no live PR, so this is verified from source/contracts, not imagery.
DONE depends on a non-null output-summary map entry gated by matching updatedAt and final thread state; DoneMetadata renders no output prose.
Pure selectors enforce root Agents working→PR→Done and child status→PR→Done precedence; branch-line ternaries render only the selected state.
Status and PR mappings cover destructive, primary, success, merged-host-color, and muted treatments with visible labels; focused tests cover every tone.
Agents working is text-only, the existing family connector receives primary tint, and both screenshots show compact two-line rows without project-level status chrome.
PR detail remains behind UrlLink and thread detail behind normal thread navigation; no hover preview, persistence, extra state line, or new RPC is present.

Current source retains filtering/search, default-open families and collapse, protected bulk deletion, context menus, split navigation, project creation, lifecycle shelves, and shared compact routing; current unit, adapter, and clean integration receipts pass.

Focused precedence/tone tests pass. Wide and compact artifacts visibly show two-line Dockside rows, blue Working and green DONE treatments, exactly three completed children, and no assistant-result prose in sidebar rows; the wide image's prose is only in the opened thread pane.

summary: All eight criteria are supported by current source/tests, five passing same-revision QA receipts with no anomalies, and direct inspection of both artifacts. PR minimal shape is established from current source/contracts because neither screenshot contains a visible PR row.
